description: This file is the main source code for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe game, including UI components, game logic, and styling following the Ocean Professional theme.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Main application widget configuring the theme and home page of the Tic Tac Toe game.

classes.name: GamePage
classes.description: Stateful widget rendering the game UI, including board, controls, and game state management.

classes.name: _ChoiceTile
classes.description: UI component for selecting player symbol (Knight or Queen).

classes.name: _BoardCell
classes.description: Widget representing a single cell in the Tic Tac Toe grid, with animation and highlight for winning lines.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application, runs the TicTacToeApp widget.

methods.name: TicTacToeApp.build
methods.description: Build method that returns the MaterialApp with theme configuration and home as GamePage.

methods.name: GamePage.createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the GamePage widget.

methods.name: _GamePageState.initState
methods.description: Initializes game state and animation controllers.

methods.name: _GamePageState.dispose
methods.description: Disposes animation controllers to free resources.

methods.name: _GamePageState.restartGame
methods.description: Resets the game board and state for a new game while preserving symbol selection.

methods.name: _GamePageState.newGameWithSelection
methods.description: Resets everything, including symbol selection, to start a new game.

methods.name: _GamePageState.playAt
methods.description: Attempts to make a move at a specified index and updates game status.

methods.name: _GamePageState._updateGameStatus
methods.description: Checks for win or draw conditions and updates game state accordingly.

methods.name: _GamePageState._cellInWinningLine
methods.description: Determines if a cell belongs to a winning line.
